items.title: WTTC Brings Together More Than 100 Global Speakers for the World's Most Influential Travel & Tourism Event: WTTC’s Global Summit
items.snippet: WTTC's 26th Global Summit in Valletta, Malta, under the theme FUTU[RE]SET, convenes 100+ speakers including ministers, CEOs, and former heads of state across eight strategic priorities for travel and tourism.

items.title: Build Inclusive Workplaces, Reap Immense Employee Loyalty: Keshav Suri
items.snippet: “They are only looking for equal opportunity and a holding hand. In return, business enterprises can get unmatched loyalty. The moment you show belongingness, these communities will stay forever,” Suri said. He pointed to The Lalit Group’s own experience, saying more than 50 per cent of its workforce comes from marginalised communities, with attrition among them at zero.

items.title: Subway restaurants operator EverBrands India files papers for Rs 600 crore IPO
items.snippet: EverBrands India Ltd, which operates Subway restaurants, has filed draft papers for an initial public offering. The company aims to raise Rs 600 crore to support its expansion plans. Proceeds from the IPO will be used to repay borrowings and fund new Subway store openings.

items.title: Luxury Travel Is Shifting from Showy Holidays to Calm, Seamless Journeys
items.snippet: Deepak Nangla, Managing Director, Premier by Brightsun Luxury travel is increasingly being judged by how little effort a traveller has to expend, rather than by how visibly expensive a holiday appears.

items.title: Rethinking India’s Tourism PPPs
items.snippet: India’s tourism opportunity is no longer limited by a lack of attractions. From heritage cities and wildlife reserves to beaches, spiritual centres and emerging leisure destinations, the country has an extraordinary portfolio. Infrastructure is improving, too. The bigger challenge is turning these individual strengths into destinations that offer a seamless, compelling and commercially sustainable visitor experience.

items.title: CMAC Group partners with iCoupon
items.snippet: ACCRINGTON, UK – CMAC Group , an airline disruption support and accommodation provider, is partnering with iCoupon to enhance passenger services during disruption. CMAC provides ground transportation services for the global travel sector. The company has become a transportation partner for iCoupon Rides. iCoupon Rides is already used by global airlines.

items.title: Taj celebrates the opening of Taj Hessischer Hof Frankfurt
items.snippet: Indian Hotels Company (IHCL) has opened Taj Hessischer Hof Frankfurt, marking the Taj brand’s debut in continental Europe and expanding IHCL’s presence in the region. Located in Frankfurt’s trade fair district, the hotel brings the historic Hessischer Hof property under the Taj portfolio, combining the building’s established heritage with the brand’s hospitality offering.
